assets.caption: FIGURE 5 — COMPARISON OF TYPICAL PIPELINE PRESSURE FOR RELIEF AND IPF (GAS LINE)
assets.description: Bar chart comparing typical pipeline pressure levels as a percentage of MAOP for Relief and IPF (gas line) systems. Relief column: hatched Accumulation zone from 100–110% MAOP, grey Incidental due to normal operation zone from 91–100% MAOP, hatched Operating zone below 91%. IPF column: hatched Accumulation zone from 100–110% MAOP, grey Incidental due to normal operation zone from 98–110% MAOP, hatched Operating zone below 98%. Legend identifies three fill patterns: Accumulation (hatched), Incidental due to normal operation (grey solid), Operating (hatched).
